name: getFreeRooms
description: Gets the free rooms of a department for a given week. Format the answer clearly, grouped by day and time slot.

year.description: Year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

week.description: ISO week number, e.g. 17. Defaults to the current week.

dept.description: Department, e.g. INFO. Defaults to the user's department.
